Frequently asked questions

When will InvoiceAI be available?

We are currently in private beta with a small group of tradies in Brisbane. We are expanding to Sydney and Melbourne in Q2 2026. Join the waitlist to get early access.

How accurate is the AI pricing?

Our AI is trained on thousands of real invoices from Australian tradies. It is typically within 5% of market rates, but you can always adjust before sending.

Does it work with my existing accounting software?

Yes! We integrate with Xero, MYOB, and QuickBooks. Invoices sync automatically so you do not have to enter anything twice.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely. We are SOC 2 compliant and all data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We never share your data with third parties.
